title: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension Am Privileges Amendment Order 2011

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension Am Privileges Amendment Order 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 of 2011
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 of 2011
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AM)
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2011.
An Order further to amend the Supreme Court
Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1,
11th October, 20111
No.F.2 (2)/2011-Pub.---The following president's order promulgated
by the President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judge (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), fir the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
Now
therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. the President is pleased to make the following.
Order:-
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges (Leave. Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) order, 2011.
(2) It shall come-
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the
first day of July, 201 I .
